about: A scroll on a dock icon (docs/adr/0045-app-expose.mdx) after natural scrolling (docs/adr/0042-scrolling.mdx, decision 6), through real libinput: the development compositor's virtual touchpad and wheel mouse (`uinput`), so this scenario runs only that way, as root. The Dock reads the scroll as delivered, as a Mac's does: up (dy below 0) opens App Exposé, down closes it, and which way the hand moves for it is the preference's. At 1, as the session ships them: two fingers down on Allo's icon open it and up close it, as on a Mac; the wheel turned away opens it and toward closes it. Allo's two windows, as in app-expose-gestures, which checks the rest of App Exposé (its flights, the keyboard). Each step checks what the shell's host received (`scroll_input`: every scroll one way, how many), the views App Exposé shows, and that neither application's React tree hears anything.

steps.name: two fingers moved down on Allo's dock icon: a trackpad scrolls naturally, so they deliver a scroll up (the content following them down), and App Exposé opens, as a Mac's Dock opens it
two fingers moved up on it: a scroll down, and it closes
the wheel turned a notch away from the person: a mouse does not scroll naturally, so a scroll up, and App Exposé opens
a notch toward the person: a scroll down, and it closes
